arguments.message:
Hi there,

When a bank transfer clears on your side but hasn’t been applied to your Meridian account, our billing team needs to locate the payment and match it to the correct invoice. To do this, please send us the transfer date, the exact amount, and the reference you used for the transfer. With those details the billing team can trace the incoming transfer and apply it to your account.

Let us know the information and we’ll get it sorted for you.

Thanks!
